The `netzero_metrics` package relies on data collated by [UK Net Zero Carbon Building Standard Pilot Version (Sept 2024), TableOE-1 & TableOE-2](https://www.nzcbuildings.co.uk/pilotversion).

::: {.callout-warning}
To enable comparison across types, currently the only metrics being consider are
those measured in **Kwhr/m2(GIA)/yr**.
:::

## UKNZCB Energy Use Intensity Targets

**Downloads**:

- [⬇️ energy-use-intensity](data/energy-use-intensity.xlsx)
- [⬇️ datapackage](data/energy-use-intensity.dp.zip)

```{python}
#| column: page
from netzero_metrics.tables import render_eui_uknzcb_targets_pivot 
render_eui_uknzcb_targets_pivot()
```
